mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 305.0), a rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 103.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a dual stress on the supply side and labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by high residential construction activity), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars signals an imminent slowdown in demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS falls below 700000 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.03.
